nodes.label: Colour Masterbatch Pellets Hero
nodes.description: Close-up macro photograph of multicolour cylindrical polymer masterbatch granules (red, yellow, cyan, magenta) scattered on a white background. Represents the Colour Masterbatch product line. Clean studio style with shallow depth of field.
nodes.subject: colour masterbatch granules
nodes.visual_style: product macro photography, white background, vibrant primary colours
nodes.marketing_purpose: hero image for Colour Masterbatch product page

nodes.label: Construction Grade Polymer Composite Hero
nodes.description: 3D CGI render of grey and white polymer pellets coalescing into a structural C-channel profile labelled 'STRUS:PROFILE C-102 | GREY/WHITE | POLYMER COMPOSITE | CONSTRUCTION GRADE'. Pellets disperse dramatically around the formed profile.
nodes.subject: construction-grade polymer composite profile formed from masterbatch pellets
nodes.visual_style: 3D CGI render, monochrome grey palette, white background, technical label overlay
nodes.marketing_purpose: hero image for Construction industry sector page

nodes.label: Consumer Goods Colour Masterbatch Hero
nodes.description: 3D CGI render of a multicoloured consumer handheld device (computer mouse) assembling itself from an explosion of multicolour polymer pellets (red, blue, green, yellow). Pellets trail off to the left, demonstrating colour-in-plastic transformation.
nodes.subject: consumer goods plastic product coloured via masterbatch pellets
nodes.visual_style: 3D CGI render, vibrant rainbow palette, white background, dynamic particle dispersion
nodes.marketing_purpose: hero image for Consumer Goods industry sector page

nodes.label: Global Reach Polymer Globe Hero
nodes.description: 3D CGI render of Earth/globe formed entirely from dark navy and white cylindrical polymer pellets, with a halo orbit of scattered pellets and faint network connection lines across the surface. Communicates worldwide presence and global distribution.
nodes.subject: global polymer distribution network visualised as a pellet-formed globe
nodes.visual_style: 3D CGI render, navy and white palette, white background, network globe motif
nodes.marketing_purpose: hero image for Contact page — communicates global reach

nodes.label: Pellet-Formed Telephone Contact Hero
nodes.description: 3D CGI render of a transparent blue retro push-button telephone with polymer granules bursting out of the handset in a water-like explosion. Text on the phone reads 'NEURAL-LINK COMM-INTERFACE / PELLET-FORMED COMMUNICATIONS DEVICE'. Playful, surrealist product concept.
nodes.subject: communication/contact concept — pellet-formed blue telephone
nodes.visual_style: 3D CGI surrealist render, translucent blue palette, white background, conceptual product label
nodes.marketing_purpose: alternate hero image for Contact page — call-to-action visual

nodes.label: Distributor Container Ship Logistics Hero
nodes.description: 3D CGI render of a large container ship built from colourful LEGO-style interlocking blocks (red, blue, yellow, green), with multicolour polymer pellets spilling and trailing from the stern. Metaphor for international masterbatch shipping and distribution.
nodes.subject: global masterbatch distribution via container shipping
nodes.visual_style: 3D CGI render, primary colour palette, white/light grey background, playful LEGO-inspired construction aesthetic
nodes.marketing_purpose: hero image for Distributors page — international logistics and distribution network

nodes.label: Blau Batch Pellet Swirl Brand Mark (JPEG)
nodes.description: Close-up macro photograph of blue and white polymer micro-beads arranged in a dynamic swirling pattern with a glossy blue polymer ribbon forming a spiral at the centre. Uses Blau Batch brand colours (blue and white). Visually abstract, brand-identity-driven.
nodes.subject: blue and white polymer pellet swirl — brand identity visual
nodes.visual_style: macro photography, brand blue and white palette, swirl/spiral composition, white background
nodes.marketing_purpose: alternate hero image for Distributors page — brand identity and pellet blending visual

nodes.label: Blau Batch Pellet Swirl Brand Mark (WebP)
nodes.description: Identical to distributors1.jpeg — close-up macro photograph of blue and white polymer micro-beads in a swirling pattern with a glossy blue polymer ribbon spiral. WebP format version of the same asset.
nodes.subject: blue and white polymer pellet swirl — brand identity visual (WebP duplicate)
nodes.visual_style: macro photography, brand blue and white palette, swirl/spiral composition, white background
nodes.marketing_purpose: WebP-optimised version of distributors1.jpeg for web delivery

nodes.label: Filler Masterbatch White Pellets Hero
nodes.description: Macro product photograph of plain off-white/chalk-white cylindrical polymer pellets scattered on a white background with shallow depth of field. Represents filler masterbatch (e.g. calcium carbonate / CaCO3 filler compound). Minimal, clean composition.
nodes.subject: white filler masterbatch pellets
nodes.visual_style: product macro photography, monochrome white-on-white, minimal studio aesthetic
nodes.marketing_purpose: hero image for Filler Masterbatch product page

nodes.label: FMPE Functional Masterbatch Packaging Hero
nodes.description: 3D CGI render of a white plastic jerry can / industrial container with white polymer pellets bursting from its opening in a dynamic liquid-like stream. Conveys the concept of functional masterbatch used in rigid plastic packaging (HDPE containers). Monochrome white-on-white palette.
nodes.subject: FMPE functional masterbatch for plastic packaging — jerry can with pellet burst
nodes.industry_sector: functional masterbatch / polymer engineering / rigid packaging
nodes.visual_style: 3D CGI render, monochrome white palette, white/light grey background, dynamic particle stream
nodes.marketing_purpose: hero image for FMPE (Functional Masterbatch Polymer Engineering) product page

edges.note: Both are macro product shots of raw masterbatch pellets on white background — product photography style siblings
Colour masterbatch pellets are the raw input; consumer goods hero shows the end-product coloured plastic application
Both depict polymer pellets — colour and construction are related product/application categories
Both are CGI renders showing pellets transforming into an end-use plastic product — same visual storytelling pattern
Both are CGI renders showing pellets forming a rigid plastic end-product — construction profile vs. packaging container
Both represent global distribution and international reach — globe and container ship are complementary logistics metaphors
Both are hero images for the Contact page — different visual metaphors (globe vs. telephone) for the same page purpose
Both are hero images for the Distributors page — container ship vs. pellet swirl brand mark
Identical image content — JPEG and WebP format duplicates of the same asset
Both show polymer pellets as primary subject matter — brand swirl uses Blau Batch blue, colour hero uses multicolour pellets
Both are product pages for Blau Batch functional/additive masterbatch lines — filler compound and FMPE are sibling product categories
Both show masterbatch pellets transforming into a plastic consumer end-product — packaging and consumer goods are adjacent application sectors
Both use blue as the dominant brand colour — contact1 uses transparent blue telephone, distributors1 uses Blau Batch brand blue pellets
Colour masterbatch is a distributed product — pellet product images relate to the distribution/logistics imagery
